title: Same Concept, Different Directions: Cross-Modal Feature Heterogeneity in Sparse Autoencoders
abstract: arXiv:2606.29888v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Vision-language models map images and text into a joint embedding space. However, these embeddings often entangle multiple semantic features, which limits their interpretability and controllability. While sparse autoencoders have emerged as a useful tool for decomposing these embeddings into monosemantic features, their application to joint embedding spaces has largely relied on an implicit, untested assumption that semantically corresponding features share the same directions across modalities. In this paper, we challenge this assumption by characterizing discrepancies in feature directions for the same concept across image and text modalities, a phenomenon we term cross-modal feature heterogeneity. translated_title: 相同概念，不同方向：稀疏自编码器中的跨模态特征异质性
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型将图像和文本映射到一个联合嵌入空间。然而，这些嵌入往往纠缠了多种语义特征，这限制了它们的可解释性和可控性。虽然稀疏自编码器已成为将这些嵌入分解为单语义特征的有效工具，但其在联合嵌入空间中的应用在很大程度上依赖于一个隐含且未经检验的假设：即语义对应的特征在不同模态间共享相同的方向。本文通过刻画同一概念在图像和文本模态间特征方向的差异来挑战这一假设，我们将这一现象称为跨模态特征异质性。我们证明这种异质性是模态分裂现象的关键驱动因素，即同一共享概念会因模态不同而激活不同的潜在特征。这一发现进一步揭示了为什么仅对潜在激活进行对齐是不够的。
tldr: 本文挑战了稀疏自编码器应用于联合嵌入空间时“语义对应特征跨模态共享相同方向”的隐含假设，首次刻画了同一概念在图像与文本模态间的特征方向异质性现象，并证明这是导致模态分裂的关键驱动因素。
en_tdlr: This paper challenges the implicit assumption that semantically corresponding features share the same directions across modalities in sparse autoencoders, characterizing cross-modal feature heterogeneity for the same concept between image and text modalities and demonstrating it as a key driver of the modality split.
